place.summary: Tai Po functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is TH. It receives notable inbound connections from Lantau Island. Visitors often continue to Lantau Island. It performs above its category average on observed experience.

opportunity_cards.title: Frequent companion: Lantau Island
opportunity_cards.detail: Tai Po frequently appears alongside Lantau Island, suggesting cross-promotion or route packaging potential.

opportunity_cards.title: Strong onward link to Lantau Island
opportunity_cards.detail: Visitors often continue from Tai Po to Lantau Island, with relatively strong journey experience.
